_about: Numbers for the {{count:key}} placeholders in parts/*.html. Add an entry together with the text that uses it. An entry is a plain value or { value, source, pending }; groups nest and are addressed with dots, as in {{count:group.key}}. Keys that start with an underscore are ignored by the build. Every figure names its source (a file and what was counted, or the command that produced it); pending: true marks a figure that is not measured yet, and build.mjs --strict refuses a page that uses one. The file is edited by hand: this report has no collector script.
_paths: Sources are repository paths.
